Fixture page

Skipped heading level

Low contrast paragraph text for the auditor to find.

Long block kept above the length the text auditors use as their floor, so the simplify and summarize paths of session scan actually have something to pick up. Screen reader users who ask for simplified text are the people this path exists for, which is why a run that cannot reach a model has to leave the words exactly as the author wrote them rather than replace them with whatever the failed call returned. The sentences here carry no meaning on purpose. They are only here to push this element past the character floor, and to give the harness a body of text it can compare byte for byte before and after a command runs against the page.

Plain readable paragraph so the page has body content. This sentence exists so Readability has an article body to extract when the read command runs against the fixture. It continues for a little while to pass minimum length heuristics.
